events.title: Stock Market Today, May 5: Iren Jumps After Announcing Mirantis Acquisition to Expand AI Cloud Capabilities
events.body: On May 5, 2026, investors weighed an acquisition to expand Iren's AI cloud infrastructure to enhance the deployment and management of containerized enterprise solutions.

events.title: MARA agrees to acquire Long Ridge Energy platform for $1.5 billion
events.body: MARA will buy Long Ridge Energy & Power from FTAI Infrastructure, adding a 505 MW gas plant and 1,600-acre Ohio campus to its digital infrastructure portfolio.
